prompt: What is the VAT rate on importation of goods used to manufacture export products?
answer:
### Short Answer
The VAT rate on the importation of goods used to manufacture export products is 12%. This is based on the total value used by the Bureau of Customs in determining tariff and customs duties, plus any applicable customs duties and excise taxes.

### Controlling Authorities
The controlling authority for this is Section 107 of the National Internal Revenue Code (NIRC), which states that there shall be levied, assessed, and collected a value-added tax equivalent to twelve percent (12%) on every importation of goods. This is further supported by Revenue Regulations No. 16-2005.

### Interpretation

### Practical Meaning
For businesses importing goods to manufacture products for export, the 12% VAT will be applicable at the time of importation. This tax must be paid prior to the release of the goods from customs custody. However, businesses that are VAT-registered may be able to recover this VAT as input tax if the goods are used in the course of their trade or business, particularly if they are engaged in zero-rated export sales.
